questions.question: Why is List<Integer> not a List<Number>?
options: Otherwise a Double could be inserted into the Integer list
questions.explanation: Generic invariance prevents the original container's element promise from being broken.

questions.question: A parameter only reads Number values from lists of numeric subtypes. Use…
questions.explanation: The list produces Number values, so producer extends applies.

questions.question: A destination must accept Integer values. Use…
questions.explanation: The list consumes Integers, so consumer super applies.

questions.question: What can safely be added to List<?> apart from null?
options: No value of a known specific type
questions.explanation: The exact captured element type is unknown.
